messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency exceeded for model-prod-llama2 on us-west-2 (observed p99 ~3.2s, baseline ~180ms). Streaming stalls observed for long-response workflows. Paging oncall.

sophia: oncall here, seeing the page. grabbing logs and will triage. @matt @jenn please standby.

matt: I can look at routing + rollout history. noticed a precision profile change pushed ~18m ago (int8-profile-v2).

jenn: confirmed — int8-profile-v2 was promoted to prod via the canary job at 10:12. metrics until 10:25 look okay, then tail jumps.

sophia: ok, timeline: deploy 10:12, tail starts degrading 10:30, alerts at 10:42. customer-facing stream jobs show stalls and partial responses.

kai: throwing some quick numbers from dashboards: p50 70ms, p95 220ms -> p95 spike to 650ms, p99 180ms -> 3.2s. error rate ~unchanged (0.2%).

matt: this smells like a quantization kernel path or KV-cache compatibility issue for long contexts. int8 can change per-token compute and occasionally evict or rehydrate KV more often.

jenn: logs snippet from a hung stream replica (tail):
```
2026-03-15T10:40:57Z GET /v1/stream model=model-prod-llama2 variant=int8-profile-v2
streaming chunk 1/40 ok
...
processing token 31 -> stall at kv_fetch_idle waiting for kernel_scratch_lock
stack: runtime::kernel_dispatch -> quant::dequant_kv_fetch -> scheduler::wait_for_slot
elapsed 2300ms
```

sophia: good capture. any correlated host-level anomalies? gpu mem, pci-e errors?

kai: host metrics look normal. we did see an increase in kernel runtime tail on a subset of GPUs (nvidia A100s) running cuda 12.2 with custom kernels. the int8 code path hit a slow path due to alignment on those drivers.

matt: ops note: the canary group was ~15% of traffic and rolled fully after auto-promote. canary logs showed a low-volume slight tail elevation but not enough to block. it amplified under production traffic patterns.

sophia: impact: multiple customers using streaming chat experienced partial stalls; SLOs breached for p99 and some streaming sessions timed out and retried. I'll record impacted customer IDs in PagerDuty.

jenn: mitigation options: 1) immediate rollback of int8-profile-v2 to previous int8-profile-v1 (fast), 2) route streaming-heavy traffic to fp16-safe variant (slower but safer), 3) patch kernel to avoid slow path (longer).

sophia: (typo) sorry — sophia: prefer rollback + traffic routing for quick fix. who can execute rollback?

matt: I can run rollback. plan: `redwoodctl rollout revert model-prod-llama2 --profile int8-profile-v1 --force --reason "tail-surge-int8-compat"`

sophia: please run + announce. after rollback we should monitor p95/p99 and streaming success rate for 15m before closing.

# around 10:52
matt: running rollback now (will route new sessions to int8-profile-v1). deploy-bot: confirm job?

deploy-bot: Rollback job 9876 started by matt. Estimated 2m.

matt: rollback succeeded. routing updated.

jenn: updating runtime routes for streaming producers to prefer fp16-safe variant for long-response routes: `redwood route set --model model-prod-llama2 --route /v1/stream --variant fp16-safe --priority high`

ops-runbooks: Recommended post-rollback checklist: 1) collect heap traces of stuck kernels; 2) tag affected hosts for kernel debug; 3) revert auto-promote policy for precision profiles until root cause identified.

sophia: monitoring now. initial post-rollback numbers: p99 down to 240ms within 90s, p95 back to ~210ms. streaming stalls dropping.

kai: confirming customer retry storms suppressed. no additional timeouts reported in last 3m.

jenn: starting a follow-up incident ticket to track root cause and remediation (kernel hotfix vs stricter canary). assigning to eng-runtime + eng-ml.

matt: immediate next steps: collect affected host IDs and kernel versions; freeze precision profile auto-promote; add a specific metric for alignment-induced kernel slow paths.

sophia: handing off to oncall-eng-runtime for deep triage. I'll stay on this thread for the next 30m then transition to postmortem channel. If anyone sees recurring tail, @sophia tag me.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged. Severity: Sev2 -> postmortem required if RCA >24h.

sophia: thanks team. summary for pager: rolled back int8-profile-v2 -> int8-profile-v1, routed streaming to fp16-safe variant, metrics recovering, follow-up ticket ENG-1192 for kernel investigation and canary policy change.

matt: notes saved. reassigning to eng-runtime (kai) for root cause.

kai: taking ownership for kernel debug + repro. will post repro steps and attach traces to ENG-1192.

sophia: closing paging rotation and marking handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
